request.prompt:
Create one isolated full-body production prototype for the Mass Effect Armax Relay Clash asset collection, faithfully reproducing the specific original game creature in the attached artist reference. Follow the actual model anatomy, proportions, surface details, colors, materials, and asymmetries. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp silhouette, neutral studio illumination. Output exactly ONE creature and ONE view, not a reference sheet. The complete head, every crest and limb, all hands and feet must fit inside the canvas with at least 6 percent transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no floor shadow, no scenery, no labels, no text, no logo. No redesign, no invented equipment, no extra body parts, no particle effects. Preserve model-side asymmetry and do not mirror the reference. This is one static pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: Eiroch, the standard native creature from Mass Effect: Andromeda, explicitly not Ancient Eiroch and not a kett Fiend. Use the LEFT, nearly frontal full creature in the reference as the pose and exact surface-color authority. Preserve its enormous blue forearms supported on closed knuckles, short gray wrinkled hind legs, chunky claws, broad hunched gorilla-like build, gray belly and chest, irregular blue-violet and rose-edged head and shoulder plates, amber eyes, large mouth with uneven sharp teeth, and long thin pink chin tendrils. Match the number, placement, shapes and orientation of the head plates in the reference. Keep natural blue hide visible over the forearms, no metal bracelets, no kett armor. Near-frontal low knuckle-supported stance matching the reference, with all extremities clearly inside the image.
